name: 1st-Level Domain Feature

blocks.text: Choose one of your domains. You gain a domain feature for that domain, as shown on the 1st-Level Conduit Domain Features table. Additionally, you gain a skill from the chosen domain, selected from the skill group indicated on the table. (Quick Build: Revitalizing Ritual and the Heal skill from the Life domain.)
